scope: Ten final paths: four production files and six tests. Exact frozen source bytes, seven preimages, complete production/regression deltas, three new test files, relevant unchanged controllers and pause/ACK consumers read. No tests, product imports, builds, device actions, remote queries, Git or source mutations.

findings.detail: Each of the three known-result branches now awaits the existing _persist(current) before returning that identical current object. No second reward amount, result ID, streak update or _emit is produced. False or thrown platform writes propagate. Exact reverse replacement of only these three additions reconstructs every original byte, including _transaction, its caller-zone tail release, _commit, _persist, migration, amounts and validation.

Platform reload remains read-only; failed reload and writes are distinguished as MemoryStorageUnconfirmed, with explicit false replies as its MemoryStorageRejected subtype. Only a true response from a same-value write completes confirmation. Production PreferencesMemoryStore opts into the new interface. Existing generic MemoryStore semantics remain available for implementations that do not have this optimistic-cache contract.

Existing round schema/owner/rules validation runs before confirmation on open. Statistics are parsed and best-value domains checked before their same-value write. A transport/confirmation failure is rethrown rather than being treated as corrupt legacy statistics. Each new confirmation is bracketed by current-profile checks; in-flight old-owner writes cannot install a late state or ACK for a new profile. The exact static owner queue and MemoryRound serialization/reward body remain unchanged.

Initial write, move commit, uncertain readback and statistics recovery require exact readback equality and one same-value confirmation at the existing recovery boundary. Uncertain recovery validates the same round ID and a nondecreasing observed revision before adopting its exact snapshot. It does not perform an additional flip or RNG draw. The original reward ID, award callback and saved rewarded receipt ordering remain unchanged.

The unchanged Dart session awaits the real controller operation before advancing _ack, then rechecks open/profile ownership; finally records rejection when no ACK was accepted. Controller errors from the new confirmation therefore do not authorize the native request. The Native original was locally rehashed; its f9 provenance remains the explicitly recorded Godot binding, not a new remote read by this reviewer.

Only the _place catch and new _retryFinishedRound change. The catch rechecks current owner/generation, then the existing _saveError pauses the clock. A nonterminal Lumo turn is rearmed only for one-player mode; a committed terminal board retries settleReward rather than dropping a new piece. Restart/dispose cancel or invalidate the pending generation. Success is delivered through the same pausable clock, so a lifecycle pause during the awaited reward prevents an immediate result dialog. All C4 bytes outside these regions, including native entry, layout, scroll geometry and touch sizing, are identical to the Root preimage.

They exercise positive delayed replies, false/throw-before-disk/throw-after-commit distinctions, fresh Dart cache versus modeled native restart, profile revocation, stale ACK blocking, exactly one reward, paused retry and canceled/terminal bot actions. Platform/native-cache models are explicitly synthetic. No execution or Android disk-loss acceptance is inferred.
